newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds ended lower again on Tuesday, extending recent declines as the market followed German Bunds.
Declines in Bunds were somewhat greater than those in Swiss bonds. The recent strength in the Swiss franc and declines in Swiss short-term interest rates bolstered EuroSwiss however.

The Swiss Treasury confirmed that will go ahead with its scheduled auction for a new Confederate bond, planned for next week. The auction will be announced Tuesday. Allocation and final terms are due Thursday. Some traders had speculated the Treasury would postpone the auction because of the weak market.
June Comi medium-term bond down 32 at 111.33
June Euro Swiss francs up two at 98.17.
